notes.title: The Rusty Longsword Midnight Update!
notes.content: To Celebrate our partnership with Midnight Studios in porting The Rusty Longsword to Xbox Series X/S, Playstation 4/5 and Nintendo Switch we've gone through the game, fixing common issues, Revamping entire story sections, and adding even more vistas to appreciate! We hope you enjoy the update!
